description: This Java class 'QueueHelper' provides utility methods for managing media playback queues, including creating queues based on media IDs, searching, and queue index validation, within an Android media browsing service.

classes.name: QueueHelper
classes.description: Utility class for handling media playback queues, including creation, searching, and validation.

methods.name: getPlayingQueue
methods.description: Builds a playback queue based on media ID and music provider, supporting genre and search categories.

methods.name: getPlayingQueueFromSearch
methods.description: Creates a playback queue from a search query.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by media ID.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by queue ID.

methods.name: convertToQueue
methods.description: Converts a list of MediaMetadata tracks into a list of QueueItems, creating hierarchy-aware media IDs.

methods.name: getRandomQueue
methods.description: Creates a queue using the first available genre from the music provider.

methods.name: isIndexPlayable
methods.description: Checks if a given index is within the bounds of the queue.
